name: Inquisitor Pious Operative
body:
Pious operatives infiltrate enemy sects and sow discord among the ranks. As masters of duplicity, pious operatives conduct their machinations alongside their adversaries; they plant seeds of doubt to subvert the enemy’s agenda and destroy heathen organizations from the inside.

A pious operative has the following class features.

Special

A pious operative cannot be lawful in alignment.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A pious operative is proficient with all simple weapons, the favored weapon of her deity, and with her choice of one of the following weapons: fighting fan, kama, kusarigama, nunchaku, sai, shortbow, short sword, shuriken, siangham, or wakizashi.

A pious operative is proficient with light armor but not with shields.
